name: Optimus
dof_breakdown: ≈28 structural actuators plus 11-DOF hands (Gen 2); a later hand revision is reported at 22 DOF
summary: Tesla's general-purpose humanoid, announced at its 2021 AI Day and first shown as a walking prototype in 2022. Tesla intends to build it at automotive scale and cost using its own battery, motor and self-driving hardware and software. A 'Gen 2' prototype in December 2023 was lighter and faster; units have been shown doing factory tasks and simple household chores.
notable: Drew the wider industry's attention and capital toward humanoids
Reuses Tesla EV and Autopilot components
